description: Track a project deadline with milestones — progress percentage, days left and a checkable milestone list saved in your browser.

faqs.a: Yes — your project, deadline and milestone checkmarks are saved in this browser's localStorage and restored on your next visit.
Progress is the share of milestones marked done. Days left counts down to the deadline from today.
faqs.q: How are progress and days-left calculated?

faqs.a: Use the ✕ button on a milestone row. To start over, clear the project name and deadline and re-save.
faqs.q: How do I delete a milestone?

howto: Enter the project name and its deadline.
Add milestones with a name and target date each.
Tick milestones off as you complete them.
Progress, days left and the checklist update and save automatically.
title: Project Deadline Tracker
